2125356508682858905.en_summary: $DELL | Dell Earnings Call (Part 3): Traditional Server Units Decline Despite 235% Revenue Growth, Agentic AI Drives Demand, Supply Shortages Expected to Worsen in 2027. AI backlog no rescheduling, financing receivables up ~$500M QoQ on $22B AI shipments. 17G servers replace ~7 older, 18G replace 12-14. Expects demand-supply gap widen in 2027, ~87x token growth by end of decade, tracking over 200 GW data center projects.
2125356508682858905.zh_summary: $DELL | Dell財報電話會議（第3部分）：傳統伺服器單位下降但收入增長235%，代理AI推動需求，預期2027年供應短缺惡化。AI積壓無重排，融資應收帳款環比僅增約5億美元，儘管季度AI出貨220億美元。17G伺服器可取代約7台舊機，18G可取代12-14台。預期2027年需求供應缺口擴大，到十年末token增長約87倍，追蹤超過200 GW數據中心項目。

2125356286753530307.en_summary: Pairs traders used to need Python for this. Now one line. $NVDA vs $AMD: stretched, snapped back, repeat. Formula: =(NVDA.C / AMD.C - MA(NVDA.C / AMD.C, 20)) / STDEV(NVDA.C / AMD.C, 20). Swap in any pair, chart, alert, backtest.
2125356286753530307.zh_summary: 配對交易者以往需要Python。現在一行即可。$NVDA對$AMD：拉伸、回彈、重複。公式：=(NVDA.C / AMD.C - MA(NVDA.C / AMD.C, 20)) / STDEV(NVDA.C / AMD.C, 20)。可換任何配對，圖表、警報、回測。
